habana-taxi.specific_finding: The summary gives an individual On your turn sequence of choosing a taxi, paying, moving a piece and visiting monuments. The complete designer-signed clarification, TricTrac post25 (March19,2004), instead says negotiations have no player order and occur simultaneously. Offers may change until every passenger of a taxi agrees; after three minutes an unfunded taxi does not depart. Once the fare is collected, all players who chose that taxi travel, subject to later event-card ejection, and arrival order is determined only after all events. Replacing that shared simultaneous negotiation/event procedure with independent player turns changes the core timing and decisions. Specific MAJOR against covered clarifications only. The author’s optional event opt-out and Panne-removal variants are not treated as printed base rules. Full setup, ending and scoring remain uncertified; no full audit or summary body repair.
